issues.description: Stock inventory reset method name is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML requires Stock.emptyStock(): void, but the template provides Stock.clearInventory(): void instead. Students following the statement may implement/call emptyStock(), while the starter code contains a differently named method, leading to confusion and potential test compilation failures if tests expect emptyStock().
issues.suggestedFix: In the template Stock class, rename clearInventory() to emptyStock() to match the problem statement/UML. Optionally keep clearInventory() as a delegating wrapper to emptyStock() to avoid breaking any existing references.

issues.description: SealSaloon.stock staticness is inconsistent between diagram and text: the problem statement explicitly requires the stock attribute (and related methods) to be static/shared across all SealSaloon instances, but the UML diagram shows an unmarked association 'SealSaloon -> Stock : stock' (no static indication), which suggests an instance-level field. This can mislead students about whether to implement stock as static or per-instance.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML consistent with the text by marking stock as static in the diagram (e.g., underline the attribute or annotate {static}), or adjust the textual requirement if stock is intended to be instance-level.
